Expose V1 execution observability APIs

  description: |-
    Add profile-scoped Attempt, timeline, Operation, artifact, and execution statistics read routes backed by the existing bounded projections. Define redacted V1 DTOs and OpenAPI operations with opaque cursors, observed timestamps, RFC 9457 failures, and ETag support, and cover the generated contract and daemon routing.
